claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 begin at 6 p.m. ET.
Both nights of WrestleMania 42 begin at 3 p.m. PT.
The pre-show for WrestleMania 42 starts at 3 p.m. ET.
The pre-show for WrestleMania 42 starts at noon PT.
WrestleMania 42 will stream on ESPN Unlimited.
WrestleMania 42 starts at 11 p.m. BST in the UK.
The first hour of the Saturday night of WrestleMania 42 will be simulcast on ESPN2.
The first hour of the Sunday night of WrestleMania 42 will be simulcast on ESPN.
WrestleMania 42 is available on Netflix internationally.
Night 1 of WrestleMania 42 features Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton.
Night 2 of WrestleMania 42 features CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns.
